featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience with Zeno Emergency Medicine. The instructors were highly knowledgeable and ensured active participation throughout the sessions. Their instructions and explanations were clear, making the concepts easy to understand and apply.

The BLS training was demonstrated effectively using mannequins, which made the learning very practical and hands-on. The ACLS guidelines were also explained in detail, following the latest 2025 protocols.

The team was extremely supportive, providing constant motivation and encouragement. The facilities were well-equipped, with high-quality mannequins and equipment that enhanced the overall learning experience.

Overall, a very enriching and well organized training program.

featured_reviews.name: Finlay Marak
featured_reviews.review_text: Came here for BLS and ACLS training. Zen plus pvt is an AHA recognised International training center. Dr Narasinh Arolkar has been in touch with me since the time I was registering for the course and helped me throughout the course through detailed teachings, explained every equipments in detail. Akshay has been helpful since day 1 till my last day. Drs Leena and Swapnil gave positive feedbacks which helped me to improve. Even though I came from Meghalaya for this course, it was worth the travel to learn under friendly, patient and knowledgeable instructors at a great place. Everything I learned was according to the latest guidelines. Applying algorithms has now become easier.

featured_reviews.name: Aaliya Mehmood
featured_reviews.review_text: I attended 3 days comprehensive BLS and ACLS workshop at Zenzo prvt ltd in Mumbai and it was a highly immersive experience. They have certified instructors who are extremely knowledgeable and seamlessly guide you. As BLS and ACLS is almost mandatory for clinical practice for every healthcare professional, I  would highly recommend this centre as the value depends heavily on where you do it (quality of training centre matters a lot).

Very Bad service, we had requested for ambulance by 4pm, but it came after 5.17 pm
Driver did not know the pickup or hospital address even though we specifically mentioned and even then the driver went to some other location, asked do I have to come there and we had to deal with way too many calls , took way too many calls to reach. Once dispatched the ambulance service didn't bother to pick calls. Despite specifically mentioning that patient was not able to walk or move, the driver came all alone with stretcher in hand saying he could not find anyone else to come along. And they have the audacity to say out of compassion they are calling for feedback after 3 days. Where was that compassion when we booked ambulance? The driver had no idea of how to use maps, dropped the patient half way as he was unable to understand navigation. Despite hip injury the patient had to go walking almost 300 metres. And at a premium rate for a 1.2 km distance. Pathetic behaviour and very bad service. A complete no for emergencies!

The service is exceptional in its logistics: pickup and drop-off are always perfectly on time, and the vehicle itself is notably neat and clean, ensuring a comfortable and stress-free ride for my pet dog. This reliability makes scheduling vet visits and other appointments incredibly seamless.

Beyond the excellent vehicle service, the staff is highly professional. Booking a ride is seamless and efficient, often completed with just a single phone call. I particularly appreciate the helpful and pleasant demeanor of the booking staff/lady, who makes the entire process effortless.

I will strongly recommend Vet Saathi's service to all other pet parents looking for a reliable, comfortable, and professional transport solution for their beloved animals.

featured_reviews.name: MALA SRINIVASAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have used Vet Saathi twice in the last 2 months and I am.extrenely happy with their services. Right from booking the service to pick up and drop off, the process is seamless and a very pleasant experience.
Work is done in one single call. Staff is professional, prompt and compassionate.
Taking a pet to the vet is a stressful experience but Vet Saathi staff and services keep me calm.

featured_reviews.name: Sk Afrin
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely happy that my Simba’s (German shepherd’s) first ever pet transport experience was with Vet Saathi, surprisingly my pet who’s not so friendly around strangers had a joyous ride with you guys.

The cab was spick and span, with all safety and medical amenities prepared for any emergencies.
I’m thankful and grateful to the entire team of Vet Saathi, from the staff who makes the bookings seem so effortless, the experienced pet handlers who bond with the pets like they are buddies and the drivers who make it a comfortable ride.

Will be patronising and using you guys regularly going forward, wishing you all the very best, keep up the excellent work!!!

Thnk you team vetsaathi🙏

featured_reviews.name: jerissa samuel
featured_reviews.review_text: Vetsaathi was a very comfortable ride for my dog. It’s usually hard to find regular cabs that allow pets, especially if you don’t have a private vehicle. So this service by Dynamic Clinic is really helpful for pet parents. The ambulance was well-equipped with the necessary medicines and services for dogs. Also, the cost is more affordable compared to other pet cab services.
